title: Biolab — Branch locations
notes: Read from the JSON the public branch-locations page loads (rendered in a browser; values copied verbatim into raw/biolab_branches). Biolab is the Al Borg group's Jordan business, so no separate Al-Borg Jordan list exists. ownership private = commercial lab group. Days whose open/close are null in the source, or where open == close (e.g. "Th 08:00-08:00"), are left out of opening_hours and listed in extra.days_without_hours; raw string kept. One branch (Bayader) has swapped coordinates - not used. Most branches list the central number +962 6 5907000. home_visit_service_chain: the site advertises a chain-wide House Call Service; per-branch availability is not stated. No test list per branch is published.
